open_obligations.what_is_open: For \(\beta\ge2\) and \(0<q<1\), derive a necessary-and-sufficient certificate that is global in the rollout nodes, and use it to partition the full nondegenerate parameter region \(\left(\beta,k,q,\delta,\omega\right)\) into shifted Chebyshev--Lobatto win, loss, and tie regimes. The certificate must specialize consistently with the three-unit witness without treating that single schedule as least favourable for the aggregate ellipsoid.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen results reduce each fixed-node weight problem to an exact convex semidefinite program, but the outer map \(p\mapsto\rho(p)\) is a nonconvex eigenvalue optimization with node-dependent moment constraints. Active-block stationarity or weight-side semidefinite duality is only local or pointwise in \(p\); it is not sufficient for global node optimality. No frozen inequality supplies a dual minorant valid simultaneously for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{k,q,\delta}\), and the quadratic witness compares one legal schedule rather than the supremum over \(\mathcal C_{n,\beta}(B,\omega)\). Thus promoting its comparison to a universal node optimum would be invalid.
open_obligations.attempted: Starting from the exact covariance tensor and the subset-lattice blocks, factor the stacked covariance matrix and apply a Schur complement. This yields the explicit fixed-node semidefinite program recorded below. Eliminating the weights leaves the global minimization of its value function over the ordered node polytope. Differentiating a fixed active eigenvalue branch gives only necessary local stationarity conditions; eigenvalue ties require convex combinations of active eigenspaces, and neither form proves a global lower bound across nodes. The exact \(q=1\) and \(\beta=1\) regimes and the small-budget bounds were then checked against \(\mathrm{prop{:}rollout\text{-}budget\text{-}elbow}\), while the \(n=3\) diagnostic was checked against \(\mathrm{prop{:}quadratic\text{-}witness}\). These checks do not close the general Chebyshev--Lobatto regime map.
